params.name: projectId
params.description: Optionally filter logs by project ID. If not provided, logs from the entire organization will be returned.

params.name: environment
params.description: The environment to filter logs by. If not provided, logs from all environments will be returned. Note that the projectId parameter must also be provided.

params.name: actorType
params.description: The type of actor to filter audit logs by. Must be provided when the actor parameter targets a non-user actor type (e.g. identity, kmipClient).

params.name: secretPath
params.description: The path of the secret to query audit logs for. Note that the projectId parameter must also be provided.

params.name: secretKey
params.description: The key of the secret to query audit logs for. Note that the projectId parameter must also be provided.

params.name: userAgentType
params.description: Choose which consuming application to export audit logs for.

params.name: eventMetadata
params.description: Filter by event metadata key-value pairs. Formatted as `key1=value1,key2=value2`, with comma-separation.

params.name: startDate
params.description: The date to start the export from.

params.name: endDate
params.description: The date to end the export at.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset to start from. If you enter 10, it will start from the 10th audit log.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of audit logs to return.

params.name: actor
params.description: The ID of a specific actor to filter audit logs by. For user actors this is the userId; for identity actors this is the identityId. When filtering non-user actor types, the actorType parameter must also be provided.

items.docs: Get all audit logs for an organization
